_README: Validated run-order for the WS1 Promo Effectiveness refresh. The driver (bin/promo-refresh-build.mjs) executes this list VERBATIM: each 'perMarket' stage runs once per entry in 'markets' with PROMO_MARKET set; each 'shared' stage runs once afterwards. A stage is either a string (a Python script) or an object {script, engine} where engine is 'python' (default) or 'node'. Order was derived by a fixed-point producer/consumer closure (scratchpad/validate_manifest_closure.py) and an ordering verifier; every JSON input a stage reads is produced by an earlier stage. STILL REQUIRED before a live refresh is trusted: run `node bin/promo-refresh-build.mjs --dry-run` to inspect, then a live read-only MY test-run and DIFF of the produced report against the current live report; correct this list until they match.
_parallel_note: A nested array in perMarket/shared is a CONCURRENT group: the driver runs its stages in parallel (bounded by PROMO_PARALLEL_CAP, default 4). SAFE ONLY for stages that provably don't read each other's outputs or write the same file. The one shared group below is the 6 mutually-independent deposit pulls (each reads only verify-action-{mk}.json + promo-config-{mk}.json + the warehouse, and writes its own distinct deposit-*-{mk}.json). deposit_afterclaim_split_pull stays OUT of the group and runs AFTER it, because it reads deposit-classify-{mk}.json. Verified output-identical to the sequential run.
_optional_note: optional:true stages are SOFT — bonus_ripple reads their outputs tolerantly, so a non-zero exit is logged and the pipeline continues. ltv_report/lifetime_by_bonus.py and bonus_value_analysis.py are CURRENTLY BROKEN by pre-existing schema drift: bonus_family.family_of() classifies by deposit_required/min_deposit, but the modified ret/vip metrics no longer carry those fields, so every code is 'unclassified' and both bail with sys.exit('no classified codes'). Until family_of is reconciled with the current metrics schema (derive family from sub_type/mechanic), the lifetime/give-back-vs-deposit enrichment degrades (bonus_ripple falls back to the last on-disk file, else None). Fix that, then drop optional.
_sg_caveats: The both-market loop (markets MY+SG) is VALIDATED FOR MY ONLY. The acq/ret/vip CODE-LIST layer IS market-complete for SG: bin/pull_tl_codes.mjs (perMarket #1) is parameterised off PROMO_MARKET->SUF and writes tl-{acq,ret,vip}-codes-{MY,SG}.json before any consumer, so vip_report/00_vip_codes.py reads tl-vip-codes-SG.json on the SG pass. The GENUINE SG gaps are these stages, which hardcode -MY and emit no SG variant: vip_report/01d_forward_outcomes.py, vip_report/cashback_incrementality.py, vip_report/cashback_breakeven.py, attribution/phase1_control_pull.py, attribution/phase1_treated_pretrend.py, attribution/phase1_matched_did.py, attribution/phase2_fatigue.py, attribution/attribution_engine.py, attribution/regrade.py. Separately: verify_action_codes.py writes NO verify-action-{MK}.json for a market with zero qualifying action codes (returns None before the dump), and ~11 downstream consumers (ggr_coverage, bonus_roi_horizon, reproduce_attribution, keeps_horizon, and the 7 deposit_* pulls) dereference va['codes'] with no None-guard, so an empty SG market would CRASH rather than skip. SG is likely built via a separate path (bin/sg_market_pass.mjs per the SG-twin design), NOT by re-running these with PROMO_MARKET=SG. RESOLVE the SG path before enabling a both-market live refresh; the MY test-run does not exercise this.
